sentences.en: I work part-time as a receptionist at a dentist's office.
sentences.zh: 我在一家牙科诊所兼职做接待员。

sentences.en: They stayed in the hotel where I am a receptionist.
sentences.zh: 他们住在那家酒店，而我正好是那里的接待员。

sentences.en: I shouldn't have hired a receptionist who couldn't speak French.
sentences.zh: 不应该雇用一个连法语都不会说的接待员。

senses.zh: (旅馆、事务所等雇用的)接待员
